name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv-postcovid
notes: H* pass 1 on a post-COVID sample with a training window that is actually bounded. Two changes from run-hstar-cv-pair.json. The scan node now wires splits.train_start_ms, so the declared train_days=730 finally bounds the fit; before this the node accepted only an upper cut and trained all-prior, growing by one validation period per fold and reaching back to the 2016 tape start. And first moves to 2022-05-06 so no fold, in training or validation, touches the February-March 2020 crash. Twenty folds is what the data supports under that constraint, against forty when COVID is allowed in.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label. One tree, five H's. Short HPO lives on the scan node, not universe.scan.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted historical SIP tape (source alpaca-sip-split, ADR-0063): AAPL's 2020 4-for-1, WMT's 2024 3-for-1 and the XLE/XLK 2-for-1s of December 2025 are all removed by the vendor, so no change of unit reads as a price move. start_ms is the study's start date, 2018-01-01 (ADR-0066) - it precedes the earliest bar any fold reads by 2y4m, and it puts XLF's 2016-09-19 XLRE spin-off, the one corporate action the vendor does NOT adjust, outside the readable window. Prices here are NOT the as-traded scale and are not comparable with any number recorded before 2026-09-03. Run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale already in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session.

features.notes: No raw lags. Keep the 46 (5 scales × 5 moments, calendar, SPY residual, industry) plus mom on those scales and ret/rv/mom at 3m/2h/3h/2s/1w (20 extra → 66). ret_lag_0 stays internal for the SPY residual. Action lookback stays 30.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals. One tree; each name still walks its own H.

pair.notes: Two names only. Rows are per-symbol frames, so this drops whole frames the way keep-symbols does. Sits after tradable so the cohort that built the features is untouched.

scan.notes: One LightGBM over the two kept names; last column is the symbol category. train_start_ms is the walk-forward left bound (ADR-0050): without it train_days is inert. No min_split_gain, which at a 5-minute label variance near 2.6e-06 made every tree a stump. The node refuses a fold whose forecast is constant, and logs the fitted window so an inert bound cannot be silent again.

walkforward.notes: Post-COVID only. First fold trains from 2020-05-01, after the crash. Twenty 63-day folds step to a last validation of 2025-08-16 to 2025-10-17, inside the 2025-11-30 cut. The AAPL 2020-08-31 split is still unadjusted in the raw tape and lands in the training window of folds 1-2 only; folds 3-20 are clean of it. go_frac is out of two names, so it takes 0, 0.5 and 1. Book lock stays deferred.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
